summary: SunPower Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of 103,109,005 common shares to accredited investors, including affiliates of named insiders, at $0.2541 per share for gross proceeds of ~$26.2 million. The price matched the September 2, 2026 Nasdaq close; closing expected September 4, 2026. The company will file a resale registration statement by October 2, 2026. Proceeds fund working capital. This is a routine capital raise under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, not a special situation. No deal premium, board recommendation, or strategic event; watch for dilution and registration timing.
